Additionally, the right giraffe's neck intersects unnaturally with the adjacent guitar's headstock, creating anatomical ambiguity. While surface textures (wood grain, fur patterns) are rendered with high fidelity, these geometric fusions and structural collapses represent fundamental generative failures that cannot be overlooked.
